title: DS-TT Ethernet port MAC address information element

fields.name: DS-TT Ethernet port MAC address IEI
Length of DS-TT Ethernet port MAC address contents
DS-TT Ethernet port MAC address contents
fields.description: The DS-TT Ethernet port MAC address contents consist of the binary representation of the MAC address of the DS-TT Ethernet port used for the PDU session, starting with the LSB bit of the first octet of the MAC address included in bit 1 of octet 3.

notes: The DS-TT Ethernet port MAC address is a type 4 information element with a length of 8 octets.
